# Cheesecake Factory Deep-Dive Analysis

Report 003 | Published 2019-12-08 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2019-12-8/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/003.json)

Restaurant growth, acquisition economics and cash returns.

This article contains both a specific caution about severe equity downside and overconfident language about dividend durability and low risk. The first is not erased by the second. Acquisition expansion later materialized, but financing stress and payout suspension are decisive adverse evidence. The option mechanics include a factual mistake independent of investment performance.

**Coverage:** All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

North Italia had 49 units at March 31, 2026, versus 45 a year earlier. Both North Italia and other FRC segments were profitable; the company operated 36 licensed international Cheesecake Factory restaurants.

### 003-C12

**Expected long-run return is approximately ten percent**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Mixed |
| Type | forecast |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | base and optimistic scenarios |
| Asset or variable | CAKE |
| Source blocks | 130, 132 |
| Thesis family | cheesecake-return |

The disclosed three-year sensitivity annualized at -6.94%; the five-year sensitivity at 5.51%, both below the approximately 10% expectation and below SPY. These are adverse outcomes, but long term had no fixed endpoint. Pandemic closures and financing altered the business path, so the model failure is not evidence that the original arithmetic was wrong.

**Direction:** See independently checked outcomes and qualifications in reason.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [CAKE historical price sensitivity](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/CAKE/history/) | Yahoo Finance | Verified in the audit

3-year comparison 2019-12-09 to 2022-12-08: CAKE -19.38% cumulative, -6.94% annualized; SPY +32.47% cumulative. 5-year comparison 2019-12-09 to 2024-12-06: CAKE +30.75% cumulative, 5.51% annualized; SPY +109.19% cumulative. First common close strictly after publication, last common close on/before anniversary. USD vendor-adjusted-close proxies include vendor dividend/split adjustments; no fees, taxes or actual subscriber trades. These are evaluator-defined sensitivities unless the claim explicitly names the horizon.

### 003-C21

**In-money puts necessarily exercise before expiration**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Wrong |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | before March 20, 2020 expiration |
| Conditions | Share price below $40 |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | CAKE March 2020 put |
| Source blocks | 172, 173 |
| Thesis family | option-assignment-mechanics |

Touching or trading below strike before expiration does not force exercise. The holder controls early exercise, and assignment depends on exercise and allocation. The cash-secured strategy can still be coherent without this incorrect certainty.

**Direction:** See reason; no return inferred.

**Timing:** Original horizon retained: before March 20, 2020 expiration

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Options assignment FAQ](https://www.optionseducation.org/referencelibrary/faq/options-assignment) | Options Industry Council / OCC | Verified in the audit

American-style exercise is the holder's decision before expiration. At expiration, exercise-by-exception thresholds and contrary instructions apply; going in the money does not itself compel early assignment.

### 003-C22

**Put premium reduces effective purchase basis**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Assignment; quoted premium received |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | CAKE put |
| Source blocks | 172, 173 |
| Thesis family | cash-secured-put-basis |

For one assigned share, $40 strike minus $1.40 premium equals $38.60 before fees and taxes. The 3.6% period yield is arithmetic, not an independently repeatable annual return.

**Direction:** Resolved as stated.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

**Mechanism:** Cash-flow identity; downside remains that of ownership below net basis.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Options assignment FAQ](https://www.optionseducation.org/referencelibrary/faq/options-assignment) | Options Industry Council / OCC | Verified in the audit

American-style exercise is the holder's decision before expiration. At expiration, exercise-by-exception thresholds and contrary instructions apply; going in the money does not itself compel early assignment.
